node.text: This map shows fine particle pollution (PM2.5) from wildfires and other sources. It provides a public resource of information to best prepare and manage wildfire season. Developed in a joint partnership between the EPA and USFS.
Track active wildfires today with our live satellite fire map. View real-time NASA FIRMS thermal hotspots and EPA AirNow smoke plumes.
